name: Hunting the Hunters
summary: Watcher Cornelius asks you to stop Rog'mar Poachers in the Riverglades. They kill people and animals, threatening all life on the plains.

sections.title: Poachers on the Plains
sections.body: Rog'mar Poachers roam the Riverglades in packs, and Watcher Cornelius asks you to confront them. They kill men, lions, and horses, making them a threat to all life in the plains. Their hunting leaves no creature safe.

faq.q: Who asks me to stop the poachers?
faq.answer: Watcher Cornelius asks you to stop the Rog'mar Poachers.
They are orcish hunters who roam the Riverglades in packs.

faq.q: Why are the poachers a threat?
faq.answer: They kill men, lions, and horses, threatening all life in the Riverglades.
The Rog'mar Poachers roam the plains of the Riverglades.
